stories.text: 🔮 PROJECTION FLIP: Ruffing the Passer is now projected to beat Mr. Action Jackson.
🪦 The eulogy is in: In My Fantasy Era gets its send-off (15.39 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Ruffing the Passer vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Ruffing the Passer 44% / 21%, Mr. Action Jackson 89% / 68%.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 46% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 33%).
📈 LINE MOVE: JAX @ BAL: BAL −4.5 at open, JAX −10 now. News: "Rookie Joe Fagnano to start Thursday night vs. Jaguars, Jesse Minter says"
📈 LINE MOVE: NYG @ PHI: PHI −5.5 at open, NYG −3.5 now. 3 league starters in it, led by S. Barkley (Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy).
🏟️ Game to watch: JAX @ BAL (Thursday 8:15 PM), 9 league starters in action with 90.16 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (JAX @ BAL): 9 league starters in action. Most riding on it: Kirbo Crushers vs Brock You Like a Hurricane (33.73 pts projected).
🤝 Rivalry week: Ramosverse leads TDsMaGee 5–2 all-time.
📝 REPORT CARD: Brock You Like a Hurricane A- (scoring A+, record A+); Kirbo Crushers D- (record F, scoring F).
🪑 Bench of broken dreams: Ruffing the Passer has started Keenan Allen just once. Starting him in Weeks 3, 5 and 6 would have meant 1 more win by now.
📉 Stock falling: Claremont In Yo Stace!'s ESPN projection is trending down.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 11% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted The Mahomies after the favorite flipped 5 times.
